title: Genuine job interview scheduling
blurb: A recruiter schedules an interview, sends a calendar invite from a company domain, and confirms there is no fee of any kind.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Rajesh, this is Ananya from the talent team at Zensar. You applied for the senior analyst role last week. Do you have two minutes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. The hiring manager would like to interview you. Would Thursday at 11 AM or Friday at 3 PM work for a video call?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. I'll send a calendar invite from my zensar.com email with the Teams link. Please have your updated resume handy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is there any registration or processing fee?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, never. We don't charge candidates anything at any stage. If anyone asks you for money in our name, please report it to us.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good to know. Anything else I should prepare?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just be ready to talk through your last two projects. The interview is 45 minutes. All the best!

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
